author: GameSpot YouTube
text:
Xbox Has Set Itself An Impossible Goal
1 billion people. An eighth of the world’s population. That’s how many people Xbox is aiming to “entertain” every day under CEO Asha Sharma’s reset.  

Yes, that number probably sounds preposterous to you. It certainly did to me. But, instead of rolling my eyes at it, I wanted to at least try and contextualize it. I’ve crunched the numbers as best I can, and 1 billion doesn’t just sound preposterous; it’s nigh impossible. Let’s break it all down.
